🔒 BUTTON PRISON / 押してダメなら押してみろ
You awaken trapped in a mysterious room. Surrounded by sparse furniture, mannequins, and countless buttons, can you find the way out? [Game inspired by a Steam Game!]

🎮 PLATFORMS
PC • Mobile • Tablet • Console • VR (Experimental)

⚠️WARNING⚠️
Please if you encounter bugs, lag, or errors, please contact us (Via-DC) or leave feedback to help us improve the experience

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite! for more upcoming updates :)

Tags: Prison, Escape, Survival, Buttons, Chaos, Puzzles, Ragdoll, Multiplayer.
